items.summary: Masco (NYSE:MAS) has appointed Brad Hiranaga as its first Chief Marketing Officer. The new role focuses on brand growth, digital acceleration, and customer-centric product and service development. Hiranaga joins Masco with prior leadership roles at Marriott, General Mills, and Cotopaxi. Masco is drawing fresh attention from investors with this new executive position centered on marketing and commercial execution.
